title: Arena
subtitle: Team suggestions that move your plan forward while you clear your daily Arena battles.

mode.xpHint: Prefers characters that can still earn XP and that your goals or active project need.
mode.powerHint: Ignores XP and fields your strongest possible team.

state.error: Couldn't load your roster, goals, or project. Try again.
state.noCharacters: You need at least three characters to get a team recommendation.

active-project.title: Active project team
active-project.description: Tuned to the characters your active project is working on.

overall-goals.title: Overall goals team
overall-goals.description: Tuned across every active goal, whichever project it belongs to.

random.title: Random team
random.description: A random draw from your whole roster.

category.broadenedNote: Not enough matching characters, so this team was widened beyond its own pool.
category.cappedNote: Fewer than three characters can still earn XP, so XP-capped characters were included.

empty.no-active-project: No active project. Mark one as your active plan to get a project-tuned team.
empty.no-active-goals: No active goals for your characters. Add a goal to get a goals-tuned team.

rationale.goal: You have an active goal for this character.

purpose.title: Arena team recommendations
purpose.content: Suggested Arena teams built from your active project, active goals, and roster, so your daily battles also advance your plan.

mode.title: XP or Power
mode.content: XP Mode prefers characters that can still earn XP. Power Mode ignores XP and picks your strongest team. Your choice is remembered.

category.title: Team categories
category.content: One team per priority: your active project, all your goals, and a random draw. A category shows an empty note when it has nothing to build from.

variants.title: Team size
variants.content: In XP Mode, the three-character team is the top pick because a battle's XP is shared among fewer characters. Larger teams are offered as alternatives.

regenerate.title: Regenerate
regenerate.content: Shuffle a new random team. This only affects the random category.
